author: trackreco
body: #### PR description: Update of the parabolic parametrised magnetic field (`ParabolicMf`) refitted to the CMS field map, and write its constants in one place. 1. *Parabolic field constants fitted to the CMS field map.* The "Parabolic" parametrised field (`ParabolicMf`, from AutoParametrizedMagneticFieldProducer), the default constructor of ParabolicParametrizedMagneticField and `portableParabolicMagneticField::Parameters` used constants fitted to the OAE parametrisation of the 3.8 T field. Against the volume-based field map (160812, the default MagneticField) they are low by 1.46 % on average, and by up to 4.7 % at the ends of the tracker. The same four constants refitted to the map over the tracker volume (abs(z) < 280 cm, r < 115 cm) follow it to 0.03 % rms: | | c1 | b0 | b1 | a | |---|---|---|---|---| | before | 3.8114 | -3.94991e-06 | 7.53701e-06 | 2.43878e-11 | | after | 3.81036 | -2.03767e-06 | 7.34495e-06 | 3.01291e-07 | The form, the validity region and the scaling with the nominal current are unchanged. `ParabolicMf` is the field of pattern recognition: CKF trajectory building (`PropagatorWithMaterialParabolicMf`) in the offline iterations, and at the Phase-2 HLT in the L3 muon iterations and the electron GSF tracking. Track fits propagate in the full map and do not use it. 2. *The constants in one place.* They were written out in `portableParabolicMagneticField::Parameters`, in ParabolicParametrizedMagneticField and in the "Parabolic" version of AutoParametrizedMagneticFieldProducer. The last two now take them from `portableParabolicMagneticField::Parameters`, a header without dependencies. The values are unchanged, stored in single precision (no change). #### PR validation: The effect on tracking was tested, using D121 ttbar PU200, CPU only (`process.options.accelerators = ['cpu']`), with which the jobs are bit-reproducible, so every difference below comes from this PR. For HLT, the default Phase-2 menu is used. For offline, the default reconstruction is used. HLT: the tracking iterations do not use `ParabolicMf`, and their MTV numbers are identical (hltGeneralTracks: efficiency / fake / duplicate rate 90.66 / 0.85 / 0.92 % in both, the same 391824 tracks). The tracks built with it: | HLT, 300 events | efficiency | fake rate | tracks | |---|---|---|---| | electron GSF tracks (L1-seeded) | 48.45 -> 48.45 % | 61.49 -> 61.49 % | 174 -> 174 | | L3 muon tracks (merged) | 73.86 -> 73.86 % | 81.43 -> 81.38 % | 813 -> 811 | | L3 inside-out muon tracks | 73.86 -> 73.86 % | 90.06 -> 90.03 % | 1569 -> 1565 | | L3 outside-in muon tracks (high purity) | 5.11 -> 5.11 % | 35.29 -> 35.29 % | 17 -> 17 | | L3 global muons | 70.45 -> 70.45 % | 24.00 -> 24.00 % | 175 -> 175 | Offline, where the CKF iterations build their tracks with `ParabolicMf` (initialStep is built by mkFit, whose tracks do not change): | offline, 100 events | efficiency | fake rate | tracks | |---|---|---|---| | generalTracks | 92.11 -> 92.11 % | 11.37 -> 11.36 % | 770225 -> 770236 | | generalTracks, high purity | 91.58 -> 91.58 % | 4.87 -> 4.86 % | 708397 -> 708390 | The efficiency is identical (the same 5971 of 6766 simulated tracks found, high purity 5937 in both); 72 fewer fake tracks in generalTracks and 110 fewer among the high-purity ones. By iteration (tracks by original algorithm, fake rate): | iteration | tracks | fake rate | |---|---|---| | initialStep | 340476 -> 340476 | 1.20 -> 1.21 % | | highPtTripletStep | 149030 -> 149063 | 23.45 -> 23.46 % | | lowPtQuadStep | 186999 -> 186947 | 9.27 -> 9.23 % | | lowPtTripletStep | 37013 -> 37003 | 38.98 -> 38.85 % | | detachedQuadStep | 50604 -> 50624 | 27.46 -> 27.46 % | | pixelPairStep | 3641 -> 3653 | 55.20 -> 55.21 % | Tracking performance is therefore ~unchanged at the HLT and offline, apart from a slightly lower fake rate; the parametrised field of pattern recognition is now closer to the map. MTV plots: [HLT](https://uaf-10.t2.ucsd.edu/~mmasciov/MIC/Phase2/MFConstants/HLT_release_vs_release_plus_parabolicMf/plots_hlt.html), [offline](https://uaf-10.t2.ucsd.edu/~mmasciov/MIC/Phase2/MFConstants/offline_release_vs_release_plus_parabolicMf/index.html) (the release in blue, with this PR in red). On CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-10-08-2300: builds without warnings, code-format clean on the changed files; the unit tests of MagneticField/ParametrizedEngine pass, and so does testParabolicParametrizedTrackerField of MagneticField/Portable (the portable field against ParabolicParametrizedMagneticField). FYI: @cms-sw/tracking-pog-l2
title: Update of parabolic magnetic field constants fitted to the CMS field map
